infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Farangis uses contacts only for commands you request.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Farangis uses your photo library only for commands you request.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Farangis uses the camera only when you request a camera action.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Farangis uses the microphone only when you request a voice action.
